name: implement-parser
prompt: Implement Parse in kv.go. Rules: each non-empty line is key=value; surrounding whitespace on the key and value is trimmed; lines starting with # are comments and are skipped; blank lines are skipped; only the FIRST '=' splits the pair, so a value may contain '='; a non-comment, non-blank line with no '=' is an error. Then write a test file covering these rules and make sure the tests pass.
